deployment.name: any platform whose budget is declared in code; a console-only budget is invisible here

preconditions.statement: A person who can open the platform's billing console is available; the agent never holds those credentials and never sets a budget itself.
preconditions.evidencePrompt: Which role? A role, never a name and never an address.

fixtures.plants: A Terraform budget with a notification channel; the finder must locate it by file and line and count it.
The same budget, declaring an amount and a currency beside it; neither may appear in the output.
A budget declared with no recipient; the evidence line must be refused, because its sentence names a role and there is none.
A budget resource named in prose and inside a string literal; the finder must declare nothing. The lesson provider-hard-limit learned after publishing, applied here before.
A project with no infrastructure at all; the recipe must say so, hand back no evidence line, and name the console as the only place left.
A CloudFormation YAML budget and a Pulumi constructor call; both branches were proved by hand first, which is why they are pinned here.
Every case's output together; none of them may say capped, protected, safe, guaranteed or cannot exceed. The first draft of this assertion passed on empty output and was corrected.

refusalTest.refusedLooksLike: a budget with no declared recipient is named and its evidence line withheld; a repository with no declared budget gets no evidence line at all and is told the console is the only place left

exposure.covered: budgets declared in this repository's Terraform HCL, CloudFormation YAML or JSON, and Pulumi constructor calls
exposure.notCovered: a budget set in a platform console, which leaves nothing here to read; a budget in a format the finder does not read; a recipient defined elsewhere and attached by a variable; whether any alert has ever reached a person, which no file can show
exposure.behind: the provider's own hard limit — an alert tells a person while the spending continues, and the hard limit is the thing that stops it

evidenceLine.template: billing-alert-set — evidence: budget configured at <location>, notifies <role>, read <date>

steps: Nothing in the repository to revert: the recipe wrote no file. The budget is removed in the platform console by the person who set it.

postconditions.buildNotWorse: run the project's own check before and after; restore every written file and refuse if it was clean and is not
postconditions.refusalLeavesNoTrace: a recipe that cannot finish writes nothing at all
